import heapq


def dijkstra(n, edges, src):
    g = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for u, v, w in edges:
        g[u].append((v, w))
    INF = float('inf')
    dist = [INF] * n
    dist[src] = 0
    done = [False] * n
    pq = [(0, src)]
    while pq:
        d, u = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if done[u]:
            continue
        done[u] = True
        for v, w in g[u]:
            nd = d + w
            if not done[v] and nd < dist[v]:
                dist[v] = nd
                heapq.heappush(pq, (nd, v))
    return dist
